description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode III (Fire, Holy)], [Twin Master Mode] and Armaments +1 to the user

description.name: Saintfire Sweep
description.text: 6/8 single attacks (0.90 each) if the user has Armaments level 0-1/2, heals the user for 20% of the damage dealt if the user has Armaments level 1, causes Armaments -1 to the user

description.name: Twin Element Mode III (Fire, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Holy 2 with Stacking] after using a Fire/Holy ability

description.name: Twin Master Mode
description.text: Grants [Fire, Holy Ability +15% Boost 3]/[Fire, Holy Ability +30% Boost 3]/[Fire, Holy Ability +50% Boost 3], [75% Critical 3]/[100% Critical 3]/[100% Critical 3] and -/-/[Instant Cast 3] if the character has at least 0/50/80% HP after using Saintfire Blade, removed after triggering

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
